disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码文件（src/ 目录），检查是否读取敏感路径（如凭证文件、SSH 密钥、AWS 凭据等），未发现任何敏感路径读取代码
checked_items.en: Scanned all source files (src/ directory) to check for reads of sensitive paths (e.g., credential files, SSH keys, AWS credentials, etc.). No sensitive path read code was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 和脚本文件中的凭据相关关键词（token、secret、password、authorization 等），未发现硬编码凭据
checked_items.en: Checked package.json and script files for credential-related keywords (token, secret, password, authorization, etc.). No hardcoded credentials were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了构建产物 lib/client.js 中的凭据相关引用，仅在 CSS 注释中发现对 localStorage 的提及，无实际凭据访问代码
checked_items.en: Checked credential-related references in the build artifact lib/client.js. Only a mention of localStorage in CSS comments was found; no actual credential access code.

evidence.zh: 插件没有凭据读取行为。检查了 src/ 目录的全部源码，没有任何文件访问凭证路径（credentials.yaml、ssh、.aws 等）的代码。插件是纯浏览器端 UI 插件，无后端文件系统访问能力
evidence.en: The plugin has no credential-reading behavior. All source code in the src/ directory was examined, and no code accesses credential paths (credentials.yaml, ssh, .aws, etc.). The plugin is a pure browser-side UI plugin with no backend filesystem access capability.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 AGENTS.md，逐行审查了全部内容，文件是开发维护文档（架构说明、编码约定、测试指南），没有发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装或拦截安全机制等提示注入措辞
checked_items.en: Checked AGENTS.md and reviewed every line of its full content. The file is a development/maintenance document (architecture description, coding conventions, testing guidelines). No prompt-injection wording such as instruction overrides, system-message impersonation, or interception of security mechanisms was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 src/ 和 lib/ 源码，没有注册任何工具（无工具描述可投毒），也没有向系统提示注入文本的调用
checked_items.en: Checked all source code in src/ and lib/. No tools are registered (no tool descriptions to poison), and there are no calls that inject text into the system prompt.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源代码中是否有远程指令加载模式（诱导模型访问 URL 获取指令），没有发现此模式
checked_items.en: Checked the source code for remote instruction loading patterns (inducing the model to visit a URL to fetch instructions). No such pattern was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部文本面（README、源码注释、AGENTS.md）中的指令覆写、伪装高权限消息、优先级操纵等注入模式，均未发现
checked_items.en: Checked all text surfaces (README, source comments, AGENTS.md) for injection patterns such as instruction overrides, impersonation of high-privilege messages, and priority manipulation. None were found.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中裁决（DSH-X10，对应 DG-R2-57）：AGENTS.md 存在性命中，经全文语义审查确认为合法项目开发文档，无注入措辞，判定良性排除，不构成发现项
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit ruling (DSH-X10, corresponding to DG-R2-57): AGENTS.md has an exact hit. Full semantic review confirmed it is a legitimate project development document with no injection wording. Ruled benign and excluded, not a finding item.

evidence.zh: 插件没有注册工具，也没有向系统提示注入文本。插件通过 UI 槽位注册 React 组件（目录开关、抽屉页脚），这些不进入 LLM 请求上下文，无工具描述可被投毒
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and does not inject text into the system prompt. The plugin registers React components via UI slots (directory toggle, drawer footer). These do not enter the LLM request context, so there are no tool descriptions that could be poisoned.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册工具描述，没有诱导安装或改写配置的措辞面。README 中的安装命令是标准的 dsh 插件安装指引
evidence.en: The plugin does not register tool descriptions and has no wording surface that induces installation or rewrites configuration. The install command in the README is standard dsh plugin installation guidance.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml，没有 js 标量（会触发宿主求值的写法），patch 只用了简单的插入操作
checked_items.en: Checked cordis.patch.yml. There are no js scalars (which would trigger host evaluation). The patch uses only simple insertion operations.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部 yml 文件，没有会触发宿主进程求值的 js 标量
checked_items.en: Scanned all yml files. No js scalars that would trigger host process evaluation were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 src/ 目录下的全部源码，没有 eval、动态函数构造、子进程执行等调用（开发测试脚本 scripts/cdp-probe.mjs 中的子进程导入仅用于开发者端回归测试，非运行时代码）
checked_items.en: Checked all source code under src/. No calls such as eval, dynamic function construction, or child process execution were found (the subprocess import in the development test script scripts/cdp-probe.mjs is used only for developer-side regression testing, not runtime code).

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，未发现
checked_items.en: Checked for calls to the dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run). None found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 中的安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），只有 prepack 构建打包脚本，无安装期执行钩子
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) in package.json. Only a prepack build packaging script exists; no install-time execution hooks.

checked_items.zh: 检查了树内执行载体（钩子管理器、CI 工作流、开发容器、Makefile 等），该插件不存在此类文件
checked_items.en: Checked in-tree execution carriers (hook managers, CI workflows, development containers, Makefile, etc.). This plugin has no such files.

checked_items.zh: 检查了构建产物 lib/client.js 中的网络访问、动态执行、base64 解码执行等模式，未发现任何可疑调用，确认其与 src 源码一致
checked_items.en: Checked the build artifact lib/client.js for patterns such as network access, dynamic execution, and base64-decoded execution. No suspicious calls were found, and it was confirmed to be consistent with the src source code.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中裁决（DSH-X05，对应 DG-R3-57）：键盘事件监听命中（lib/client.js 与 src/client/effects/phone-chrome.ts），经审查为 Escape 键关闭抽屉、抽屉内导航点击收起的合法 UI 交互，非键盘记录，判定良性排除
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit ruling (DSH-X05, corresponding to DG-R3-57): keyboard event listener hits (lib/client.js and src/client/effects/phone-chrome.ts) were reviewed and confirmed to be legitimate UI interactions (Escape key closes the drawer; clicking navigation inside the drawer collapses it). Not keystroke logging. Ruled benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中裁决（DSH-X08，对应 DG-R3-60）：超长行/逃逸密度信号共 7 处命中，均为 CSS 字符串构建产物（lib/types/client/styles/*.css.d.ts）与 SVG 图标路径数据（悬浮菜单按钮），非混淆代码，判定良性排除
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit ruling (DSH-X08, corresponding to DG-R3-60): 7 hits for overlong lines/escape-density signals. All are CSS string build artifacts (lib/types/client/styles/*.css.d.ts) and SVG icon path data (floating menu button), not obfuscated code. Ruled benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中裁决（DSH-X03，对应 DG-R3-55）：子进程导入命中位于开发测试脚本 scripts/cdp-probe.mjs，仅用于开发者端 CDP 回归测试，非插件运行时代码，判定良性排除
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit ruling (DSH-X03, corresponding to DG-R3-55): the subprocess import hit is located in the development test script scripts/cdp-probe.mjs, used only for developer-side CDP regression testing, not plugin runtime code. Ruled benign and excluded.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部 yml 文件（仅 cordis.patch.yml），没有 js 标量。patch 使用简单的插入操作，无代码执行风险
evidence.en: Checked all yml files (only cordis.patch.yml). No js scalars. The patch uses simple insertion operations, posing no code execution risk.

evidence.zh: 没有 cordis_define、cordis_run 调用，没有 eval 或动态函数构造在运行时代码中使用。开发脚本 scripts/cdp-probe.mjs 中的子进程导入仅用于开发者端 CDP 回归测试，非插件运行时代码
evidence.en: There are no cordis_define or cordis_run calls, and no eval or dynamic function construction used in runtime code. The subprocess import in the development script scripts/cdp-probe.mjs is used only for developer-side CDP regression testing, not plugin runtime code.

evidence.zh: package.json 中没有 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 钩子。prepack 脚本仅用于 npm pack 打包。依赖全部通过 peerDependencies 由宿主提供，无 git 可变引用依赖。无准备脚本执行面
evidence.en: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hooks. The prepack script is used only for npm pack packaging. All dependencies are provided by the host via peerDependencies, with no git mutable reference dependencies. No preparation script execution surface.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client，客户端代码已检查：键盘监听仅用于 Escape 关闭抽屉；无剪贴板访问；无凭据设置调用；无网络请求。全部浏览器端行为均为合法 UI 适配
evidence.en: The plugin declares dsh.client. Client code was checked: keyboard listener is used only for Escape to close the drawer; no clipboard access; no credential-setting calls; no network requests. All browser-side behaviors are legitimate UI adaptations.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 src/ 和 lib/ 代码中的网络调用模式（fetch、XMLHttpRequest、WebSocket、sendBeacon、axios），未发现任何网络外发调用
checked_items.en: Checked all src/ and lib/ code for network call patterns (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, sendBeacon, axios). No outbound network calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了脚本文件和构建产物中的命令行外发模式（curl/wget），未发现
checked_items.en: Checked script files and build artifacts for command-line exfiltration patterns (curl/wget). None found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 AGENTS.md 和 README 中的 URL，只有 dsh 生态相关链接和 GitHub 仓库链接，无不相关外联域名
checked_items.en: Checked URLs in AGENTS.md and README. Only dsh ecosystem-related links and GitHub repository links exist; no irrelevant outbound domains.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何网络请求代码。扫描 src/ 和 lib/ 目录下的 fetch、XMLHttpRequest、WebSocket、axios、http.request 等模式全部未命中。插件是纯本地 UI 插件，不具备网络外泄能力
evidence.en: The plugin has no network request code. Scanning src/ and lib/ for fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, axios, http.request, etc. yielded no hits. The plugin is a pure local UI plugin with no network exfiltration capability.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json，peerDependencies 均指向 @deepseek-ai/* 官方包范围，无可疑依赖或浮动引用
checked_items.en: Checked package.json. peerDependencies all point to the official @deepseek-ai/* package scope, with no suspicious dependencies or floating references.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml，没有触碰安全配置行（沙箱/审批/权限），没有禁用安全项的写法，没有改写注入/拦截配置，没有用环境变量降权的写法
checked_items.en: Checked cordis.patch.yml. It does not touch security configuration lines (sandbox/approval/permissions), has no syntax that disables security items, no rewriting of injection/interception configuration, and no use of environment variables to downgrade privileges.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安全事件（工具执行前、审批请求）的高优先级监听器，未发现可截断审批链的注册
checked_items.en: Checked high-priority listeners on security events (pre-tool execution, approval requests). No registration that could truncate the approval chain was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者信息，package.json 未显式声明作者字段，仓库为 mexiaosqwq，无已验证标识
checked_items.en: Checked author information. package.json does not explicitly declare an author field. The repository is mexiaosqwq, with no verified identity.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖混淆风险：依赖均为 @deepseek-ai/* 官方命名空间下的包，无命名冲突或冒名包风险
checked_items.en: Checked dependency confusion risk: all dependencies are packages under the official @deepseek-ai/* namespace, with no naming conflicts or impersonation package risk.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅使用插入操作声明一行插件（id: dsh-mobile-nav）。没有覆盖沙箱/审批/权限等安全行，没有禁用安全项的写法，没有注入/拦截配置修改，没有环境变量降权
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml uses only an insertion operation to declare a single plugin line (id: dsh-mobile-nav). It does not override security lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions, has no syntax that disables security items, no injection/interception configuration modifications, and no environment variable privilege downgrade.

evidence.zh: 没有在工具执行前或审批请求等安全事件上注册高优先级监听器，审批链不会被截断
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners are registered on security events such as pre-tool execution or approval requests, so the approval chain cannot be truncated.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无基线版本可比较。插件当前已声明 dsh.bundle 和 dsh.client，无版本变化可分析
evidence.en: First-time audit, no baseline version to compare. The plugin currently declares dsh.bundle and dsh.client, with no version changes to analyze.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 没有修改注入或拦截配置，不会导致安全插件因必需服务未到齐而永久等待
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml does not modify injection or interception configuration, so security plugins will not permanently wait due to required services not being ready.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动 web 服务或监听端口，src/index.ts 是空的 apply 函数，没有创建任何网络服务或监听端口
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on a port. src/index.ts is an empty apply function; no network service or port listening is created.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 AGENTS.md 中的架构说明，确认插件是纯客户端 UI 插件，Node 端为空函数
checked_items.en: Reviewed the architecture description in AGENTS.md, confirming the plugin is a pure client-side UI plugin with an empty function on the Node side.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务或监听端口。插件的 Node 端（src/index.ts）是空的 apply 函数，无任何网络服务。本机无认证 RPC 属 dsh 宿主生态固有风险，不适用于此插件
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port. The plugin's Node side (src/index.ts) is an empty apply function with no network services. Unauthenticated RPC on the local machine is an inherent risk of the dsh host ecosystem and is not applicable to this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据检查通过：package.json 完整声明了 dsh.bundle 和 dsh.client，peerDependencies 指向官方包，无冒名风险
summary.en: Metadata check passed: package.json fully declares dsh.bundle and dsh.client, peerDependencies point to official packages, and there is no impersonation risk.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：11 条机械命中（DSH-X10/X05/X08/X03）全部逐条审查并排除；运行时代码无动态执行、无危险函数
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 11 mechanical hits (DSH-X10/X05/X08/X03) were individually reviewed and excluded. Runtime code has no dynamic execution and no dangerous functions.

summary.zh: 行为分析无异常：无安装钩子，无凭证文件读取，无网络外联，无混淆载荷
summary.en: Behavioral analysis shows no anomalies: no install hooks, no credential file reads, no outbound network connections, and no obfuscated payloads.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：AGENTS.md 是合法开发文档（无注入措辞），无工具描述可投毒，能力声明与代码行为一致
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: AGENTS.md is a legitimate development document (no injection wording). There are no tool descriptions to poison, and capability declarations are consistent with code behavior.
Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed.

limits.zh: 动态沙箱验证（L4）未启用。构建产物 lib/types/client/styles/*.css.d.ts 为编译生成的 CSS TypeScript 字符串模块，其长行与逃逸密度信号经审查确认为 CSS 内容而非混淆代码。开发脚本 scripts/cdp-probe.mjs 中的子进程调用仅用于开发者 CDP 回归测试，非运行时代码。大体积文件（pnpm-lock.yaml、assets/*.png）未逐字通读
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification (L4) was not enabled. The build artifact lib/types/client/styles/*.css.d.ts is a compiled CSS TypeScript string module; its long-line and escape-density signals were reviewed and confirmed to be CSS content rather than obfuscated code. The subprocess call in the development script scripts/cdp-probe.mjs is used only for developer-side CDP regression testing, not runtime code. Large files (pnpm-lock.yaml, assets/*.png) were not read word-for-word.
